morecloudlayers.config.title: More Cloud Layers
morecloudlayers.config.layerCount.toolti: How many extra cloud layers to add above the vanilla layer (1-8).
Each layer moves this much slower than the one before it. Ignored when Speed Mode is Random.
morecloudlayers.config.sizeDropPercent.t: Each layer's cloud tiling shrinks by this much compared to the one before it. Ignored when Size Mode is Random.
morecloudlayers.config.randomTransparenc: Each layer gets a random opacity between 75% and 100%.
